messages:
eva: FYI the API ref for /v1/classify shows parameter `response_format: 'jsonl'` in examples but the service expects `format: 'json_lines'`. I ran into a customer script that failed because of this mismatch.

sam: Thanks, that's a subtle rename we missed when consolidating enums. Can you open a small PR to update examples (curl/py/js) and add a migration note?

eva: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12845 — I changed examples to use format: 'json_lines' and added a one-line compatibility note: "format aliases: we accept both 'jsonl' and 'json_lines' for a transition period; prefer 'json_lines' in new integrations."

sam: Nice. For SDK snippets, show a short mapping helper so older clients still work:```js
const fmt = params.format || params.response_format || 'json_lines';
```

doc-bot: docs lint OK. staging build started for branch fix/classify-format (preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/api/classify).

eva: Preview looks good. @sam can you approve the PR and add a tiny example test that checks for 'json_lines' in the sample bodies so we don't regress?

sam: Will do. Merging after tests added. Closing once merged. :white_check_mark:
